description: This file defines an interface for visitors of entity conditions in the OFBiz framework, implementing the visitor design pattern. It declares methods to visit different types of entity condition components such as expressions, condition lists, field maps, and raw string conditions.

classes.name: EntityConditionVisitor
classes.description: An interface implementing the visitor pattern for various entity condition types in the OFBiz framework, allowing custom operations over different components of entity conditions.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Performs an operation on an EntityNotCondition object.
